articles.title: Purdy authors 'close to a perfect game' with 5 TDs
articles.summary: With 44-year-old Colts quarterback Philip Rivers and his comeback occupying most of the headlines entering Monday's game, it was Brock Purdy who stole the show, throwing five touchdown passes in leading San Francisco to a 48-27 win at Lucas Oil Stadium.

articles.title: Metcalf suspended two games for fan altercation
articles.summary: The NFL has suspended Steelers wide receiver DK Metcalf for two games without pay due to his altercation with a fan at Detroit's Ford Field on Sunday.

articles.title: Rivers turns back clock but can't will Colts to win
articles.summary: Newly unretired Philip Rivers turned in an impressive individual performance Monday night that saw him throw for 277 yards and two touchdowns. But it wasn't enough to deliver the Colts a win against the 49ers as Indianapolis saw its playoff hopes fade.

articles.title: Chiefs agree to deal to move to Kansas in 2031
articles.summary: The Kansas City Chiefs announced Monday that they have entered into an agreement with the state of Kansas to play their games there beginning in 2031.

articles.title: Bills coach anticipates Allen (foot) OK for Eagles
articles.summary: Bills quarterback Josh Allen is day-to-day with the right foot injury he suffered in Sunday's win, with coach Sean McDermott saying he anticipates Allen will be available for Week 17's game against the Eagles.

articles.title: NFL suspends Chargers LB Perryman two games
articles.summary: The NFL suspended Chargers LB Denzel Perryman two games cited repeated violations of player safety rules, including during Sunday's win over the Cowboys.

articles.title: Ravens' Harbaugh not worried about job status
